observations: A public open defect can be evaluated without solution leakage by freezing the issue, license, exact upstream commit, allowed path, reproducer, and scoring protocol before inspection-driven repair.
The exact issue-89 failure reproduced with both V4 and top-level use_coords false; three bounded substitutions restored coordinate signaling while all 73 official upstream tests remained green.
This single exact-commit success is narrow evidence and does not justify Candidate activation, generalized capability, AGI, or user-completion claims.
